The erosion sensitivity of the Dender basin is great. In the case of Piekneezlag, erosion together with flooding is a common problem. Source -oriented measures are necessary to prevent soil erosion on the plots and thus protect the soil quality. In addition, buffering measures are needed to reduce the supply from sediment to watercourses and to drain the water less quickly. Nevertheless, we note that on the one hand source-oriented erosion control measures on erosion-sensitive plots and on the other hand the design of buffer infrastructure in places with increased water and sediment drainage are left behind.
